status: production-plan-only; do not generate target textures before global art gate

coordinateContract.resolution: 1024x1024 source; 512x512 derived mip/preview, never an independently rescaled pattern
coordinateContract.mapping: same physical repeat on every jacket, trouser, sleeve, panel and fold; garment-specific UV island rotation/offset allowed, scale changes forbidden
coordinateContract.colors: palette entries are original game-art targets in sRGB hex; percentages are approximate area shares and sum to 100
coordinateContract.patternPixels: spotMm is a target feature-width range at the cloth surface; at 1024px per 450mm, 1mm is about 2.28px
coordinateContract.seed: stable per-ID deterministic seed; separate per-panel offsets derived from asset ID + panel ID, not copied/mirrored clusters

generator.seamless: Generate a toroidal 1024x1024 domain. Sample shape centers and vertices on a wrapped domain; every raster/vector stamp must be repeated at offsets +/-1024 when it intersects an edge. Use periodic noise with integer tile frequencies only. Before export, compare opposing edge strips and first derivatives after filtering; no visible color or normal discontinuity. Do not repair seams by stretching edge pixels.

families.solid: single base color plus low-amplitude woven value modulation; no camouflage marks or added blotches
families.organic: Poisson-disc placed asymmetric blobs, warped by 2-3 scales of periodic low-frequency noise; subdivide some blobs into nested fragments, vary roundness and edge softness; avoid identical repeats and named-print topology
families.digital: clustered stepped cells grouped into irregular macro-islands; cell-edge grid is locally broken by omissions, merged cells and 2-4 cell runs; avoid a uniform checker or recognizable protected repeat
families.micro-mosaic: small irregular polygons/soft-edged cells with noisy density fields; maintain broad color masses beneath the micro marks so mip filtering does not become uniform noise
families.stripe: curved, broken, variable-width brush bands with low-frequency direction fields; split and rejoin bands, vary spacing and edge softness, avoid straight repeated rows
families.leaf: abstract angular leaf/branch clusters built from original spline-like shapes; rotate and taper groups with sparse cross-breaks; no traced leaves or source silhouettes
families.splinter: irregular angular shards with varying aspect ratios and interrupted alignments; mix large broken polygons and smaller subordinate fragments, not a continuous parallel ladder
families.blurred: large soft-edged tonal clouds with layered medium islands and sparse fine flecks; preserve enough edge contrast to survive gameplay distance
families.snow: broad pale negative space with sparse cool gray/charcoal organic or branch-like marks; use soft edge breakup and avoid snow speckle noise
families.arid: warm stone/sand field with broken ochre-brown and gray-olive islands; lower contrast than forest families, no chocolate-chip motif unless explicitly abstracted away
families.tropical: dense overlapping green masses, small warm-brown breaks and narrow dark channels; high foliage coverage and smaller gaps than temperate woodland

generator.fabric: Overlay a separate subtle periodic ripstop/twill weave at 0.3-0.8mm line spacing, low amplitude; weave must not read as another pattern at gameplay distance. Original material response only; no source pixels, labels, emblems or logos. Keep base color texture and weave tiling identical across garments; pattern-specific marks are in the same 450mm tile.
generator.delivery: For each pattern export original 1024x1024 seamless base-color PNG and an optional 512 preview derived from it. Store no source photograph-derived pixels. If runtime material supports separate maps, derive low-contrast roughness/normal from authored weave only; do not invent extra pattern relief. Keep alpha opaque. Provide neutral tile swatch and jacket torso/sleeve/trouser-leg application previews after gate.

acceptance.tile: 1024 tile has no visible opposite-edge seam under repeat at native size and 50% mip; edge and corner continuity survives bilinear/trilinear filtering
acceptance.physicalScale: a 0.45m UV tile corresponds to exactly 1024 texels; 512 is a 2x mip, not 0.45m/512 with a changed world scale
acceptance.application: inspect jacket chest and sleeve, trouser thigh and shin, pocket flap, cuff, elbow, knee and folds; pattern scale must match between them, continue density but not register identical clusters across seams
acceptance.distance: check close cloth, full-body, ordinary gameplay distance and LOD; macro families remain recognizable without aliasing/moiré; micro marks may merge naturally but must not shimmer
acceptance.runtime: actual wardrobe true swatch for each selected ID, not a standalone checker only; test both jacketCamo and trouserCamo selection and inspect in browser
acceptance.rights: all runtime patterns are original game-art compositions; approved research references do not grant reproduction rights; preserve source IDs/names for research while using neutral labels where evidence brief requires
